Read the copied SKILL.md: lines 158-193 contain the extraction ladder with rungs 0-3 (search-by-shape L162, local-have L168, standalone-lemma L186, split-long-proof L190), matching the four children verbatim; the min_comm worked example (L171-183) instantiates have h twice via exact h a b / exact h b a and closes both le_antisymm goals, so the decomposition is what the entry says and closes.

Move is stated as a four-rung ladder (search by shape, local have, standalone lemma, split) independent of the single min_comm worked example; applicability.goal_shape/use_when/avoid_when restate the rungs as general conditions. 'When not to use' maps each avoid-condition to a rung (existing theorem fits=rung 0; used once with no independent meaning=rung 2 negation; no hypotheses dropped; non-Mathlib house style, matching the skill's 'When NOT to Use' CONTRIBUTING caveat). Consequences are specific and honest, including the caveat that min_comm stops at rung 1 and never exercises rung 2, and an explicit under-/over-generalisation treatment.
